title: Closeout and Contain the Drive
description: A defender closes out hard on a catch, then must contain a live drive without fouling or giving up an easy middle drive.

content.objective: Close out under control and then contain whatever the shooter decides to do next.
content.setup: A defender starts in a help position as a shooter catches on the wing.
instructions: The defender sprints to close out, chopping the feet down on the last two steps.
If the shooter attacks, the defender contains the drive by sliding, not lunging.
If the shooter holds, the defender contests the shot with a high hand, staying down.
Rotate the shooter's decision randomly across reps.
coachingPoints: Chop the feet on the approach so the closeout lands balanced.
Stay low on the contest — jumping out of control gives up the drive.
Keep the hands active without fouling.
commonMistakes: Flying in too fast and losing balance on the closeout.
Standing straight up to contest instead of staying in a stance.
Standing upright instead of staying in a low stance.
content.safety: Contest verticality only; no reaching across the shooter's body.
